integrity: All displayed density, moment, stochastic-order, and limit claims follow from the axiomatic four-class edge-pair decomposition and exact endpoint-route formulas; a standalone exact-rational checker provides independent finite-case corroboration.
limitations: The network is the unit-edge incidence graph of a finite projective plane of an existing order q>=2; no claim for arbitrary edge weights or nonexistent planes. A historical 1982 full text was inaccessible. Reproducible finite checks do not replace the infinite proof.
title: Exact arclength-distance law and likelihood-ratio ordering for projective-plane incidence networks
